title: “Just a strange pic”: Evaluating ‘safety’ in GenAI Image safety annotation tasks from diverse annotators’ perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing annotator harm ratings ('harm-to-self' vs 'harm-to-others') and qualitative comments on AI-generated images containing gender-related depictions and stereotypes, including testing rating differences when filtering out gender-specific content.

Analyzing annotator harm ratings and qualitative comments on AI-generated images containing race-related depictions, stereotypes, and slurs, including testing rating differences among demographic groups when filtering out race-specific content.

Analyzing annotator harm scores and qualitative comments on AI-generated prompt-image pairs containing specific nationality depictions and testing if filtering out these depictions changes the rating behavior of diverse annotators.

Collecting safety and harm annotations on prompt-image pairs depicting specific age groups (e.g., children and older adults) from the Adversarial Nibbler dataset to evaluate annotator perception of harm.
